evidence.summary: For a finite nonempty subset $A$ of an abelian group, let $σ(A)=|A+A|/|A|$ and $δ(A)=|A-A|/|A|$. evidence.title: Can AI agents conduct open-ended AI research? Early evidence from two case studies
evidence.summary: Forecasts of explosive AI progress hinge on AI agents automating AI research. But evidence on whether agents can carry out open-ended AI research is thin. Current evaluations either test agents on narrow, verifiable tasks, which excludes open-ended research, or submit AI-generated papers to blind peer review, which is overstretched, stochastic, and suffers from poor review quality.
